subject: Is it possible to add a botton in the headerPanel?

messages.author: 62e162fba4d974a5
messages.subject: Is it possible to add a botton in the headerPanel?
parts:
I would like to add a button, Home, to let users go back to the homepage by clicking it.
I tried to attach the following code in the headerPanel, but it didn't work.

HTML("<a class='btn btn-mini btn-info' href='host_name/index.html'>Home</a>")

It works in the siderbarPanel; is there anyway to make it shows up on the top right of the headerPanel?
Thanks.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to add a botton in the headerPanel?
parts:
Just make your own variation of headerPanel and use it instead. This is what headerPanel looks like:

headerPanel <- function(title, windowTitle=title) {    
  tagList(
    tags$head(tags$title(windowTitle)),
    div(class="span12", style="padding: 10px 0px;",
      h1(title)
    )
  )
}

You could add your button inside the div. You might want to also add the "pull-right" class to the <a> so it puts itself on the right.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Is it possible to add a botton in the headerPanel?
parts:
Just FYI, you never need to switch from ui.R to index.html; ui.R's capabilities are a superset of index.html.

The widgets in Shiny are, by design, a very very thin layer, meant for you to take them apart and create your own forked versions. Type shiny::downloadButton into your R console and you get this:

> shiny::downloadButton
function (outputId, label = "Download", class = NULL) 
{
    tags$a(id = outputId, class = paste(c("btn shiny-download-link", 
        class), collapse = " "), href = "", target = "_blank", 
        label)
}
<environment: namespace:shiny>

So if the class parameter had not existed on downloadButton, you could just copy out the code and tweak the class yourself.
